notes: Design notes are included. DeepSeek/ChatGPT use card/level notes; GPT 6.0 Sol, Kimi, Gemini and GPT 5.6 Luna use card-level manifests/notes; XD-01 is a D2 hard variant with a card README plus per-level notes. The GPT 5.6 Luna deep-thinking run uses the revised experimental prompts and is placed after ChatGPT (web, free).
caution: n=1 per model/card; no repeats; no formal K/M scoring; ChatGPT and Gemini versions not captured; the GPT 5.6 Luna run is a deep-thinking web run, not an independent API model; XD-01 is a stress test and its failures are part of the result; the L5 is animated but still structurally distorted; the static first attempt is archived.
